title: Only Human
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 25. Original VOA MP3 with selected exact original English dialogue and WorldVoice Arabic translation. Full VOA transcript at the source; this in-app excerpt is not the complete text. No sentence-level timestamps have been reviewed. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.text: When last we saw Anna, she had made a new friend. And they had been talking about superheroes for a while when suddenly Anna became Lightning Bolt Lady!
dialogue.translation_ar: في آخر مرة رأينا فيها آنا، كانت قد كونت صداقة جديدة، وكان الاثنان يتحدثان عن الأبطال الخارقين، وفجأة أصبحت آنا سيدة الصاعقة!

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.text: She tried to find her superpowers. But it did not go well.
dialogue.translation_ar: حاولت اكتشاف قواها الخارقة، لكن الأمور لم تسر جيدًا.

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.text: She can’t fly, become invisible or create a force field. And she really cannot walk through walls.
dialogue.translation_ar: إنها لا تستطيع الطيران أو الاختفاء أو إنشاء مجال حماية، ولا تستطيع المرور عبر الجدران.

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.text: She had been walking into that wall for about 15 minutes when she had a great idea.
dialogue.translation_ar: كانت تصطدم بالجدار منذ نحو 15 دقيقة عندما خطرت لها فكرة رائعة.

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.text: I just had a great idea!

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.text: I can’t wait to hear this one! But first, let’s talk about grammar.
dialogue.translation_ar: لا أطيق الانتظار لسماعها! لكن لنتحدث أولًا عن القواعد.

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.text: Professor Bot is on vacation this week. I’m the announcer. So, I’m going to tell you about the past perfect continuous.
dialogue.translation_ar: الأستاذ بوت في إجازة هذا الأسبوع، وأنا المعلق، لذا سأشرح لكم زمن الماضي التام المستمر.

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.text: We use this verb tense to show that an action started in the past and continued to another time or action in the past.
dialogue.translation_ar: نستخدم هذا الزمن لبيان أن حدثًا بدأ في الماضي واستمر حتى وقت أو حدث آخر في الماضي.

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.text: Had been walking is the past perfect continuous of the verb walk.
dialogue.translation_ar: عبارة had been walking هي صيغة الماضي التام المستمر من الفعل walk.
